title: Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate Cake and Cupcakes
hookLine: Saudi Arabian-inspired pistachio kunafa chocolate cake and cupcakes with 13 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: For Chocolate Cake:Ready all the ingredients. Powder the oreo biscuits, pinch salt and mix warm milk as needed and make a cake batter. Add in baking powder and vinegar and mix. Grease a loose bottomed tin. Pour a 1cm thick layer of the batter. Bake in a preheated oven @160°C for 7-8 minutes or until the knife comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. Incorporate {m53224_1}, {m53224_2}, {m53224_3}, and {m53224_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure white chocolate first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: For Homemade Pistachio Paste:Ready all the pistachio paste ingredients. Slightly melt white chocolate on a double boiler.(else the mixer blade may break) Coarsely powder the pistachio in mixer. Add in condensed milk. Add in slightly warmed and slightly melted white chocolate and milk as required and crush to a smooth paste.(Green food colour can be add. I haven't.) For Kunafa: In a kadhaai take ghee and roast the sevaiiya on slow gas. Keep stirring until a pleasant roasted aroma releases. Cool it. Add in the Homemade pistachio paste.Mix well. Incorporate {m53224_5}, {m53224_6}, {m53224_7}, {m53224_8}, {m53224_9}, {m53224_10}, {m53224_11}, {m53224_12}, and {m53224_13} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Lip smacking Kunafa is ready. Spread a 2 cm layer on the cooled chocolate cake. Melt dark chocolate and strained malai and prepare the chocolate ganache. Cool and pour on the Kunafa layer. Garnish Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate Cake with chopped pistachio and silver balls. Keep in fridge for 2-3 hours. Then unmould the Kunafa Cake.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: I also prepared Kunafa cupcakes. Cut and enjoy. The cake looked so pretty that we could either save it or have it!! ☺ Cross sectional view of the Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate Cake. Enjoy with a new sweet delicacy this festive season with family and friends.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
